subject: Ops integration deep-dive: proposed agenda, pre-reads, and reschedule options
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudworks.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops integration deep-dive: proposed agenda, pre-reads, and reschedule options

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical deep-dive to walk through the integration surface between Redwood and CloudWorks. We want to make this focused (60–75min) and actionable so your engineering and platform teams can validate the network/infra model and ops runbook.

Proposed high-level agenda (60 min):
- 5m: Introductions & goals
- 15m: System overview & integration points (Redwood architecture)
- 20m: Network, VPC peering, and security controls (CloudWorks questions welcome)
- 10m: Autoscaling & capacity/SLAs (Dedicated routing, burst policies)
- 10m: Open Q&A + next steps / mutual action items

Pre-reads attached: redwood-ops-deep-dive-agenda.pdf and system-diagram-v2.svg. Also linking a short pre-read note with details on typical peering configs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4Dredwood-cloudworks-pre-reads

We had tentatively suggested Wed 7/8 10:00–11:15 PT but if that doesn't work for you, please propose 2 alternative 60–75 min slots next week.

Who from your side will be on the call? If possible, include someone who owns networking/VPC and someone owning infra ops.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-ops-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (application/pdf), system-diagram-v2.svg (image/svg+xml)

From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudworks.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWorks Engineering <eng@cloudworks.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops integration deep-dive: proposed agenda, pre-reads, and reschedule options

Thanks, Tessa — appreciate the clear agenda and the diagrams.

We definitely want the networking/VPC section to be first-class — our infra lead, Priya Shah (cc'd on eng alias), will want to dig into routing and NAT implications. A couple asks before we lock the slot:
- Can you add a 10-15m breakout on data residency and retention patterns? We have compliance folks who will listen in.
- Could you also include a short segment on model variant fallback & graceful degradation (what happens if Dedicated capacity is constrained)?

On timing: 7/8 10am PT is a bit tight for our EMEA folks. Our 2 alternatives: 7/9 09:00–10:15 PT or 7/12 13:00–14:15 PT. Prefer 7/12 if you can accommodate.

Samir
VP, Product & Partnerships
CloudWorks Inc.

---
On Thu, Jul 2, 2026 at 09:12, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samir —
> 
> Thanks again for agreeing to a technical deep-dive...

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudworks.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops integration deep-dive: proposed agenda, pre-reads, and reschedule options

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround and good suggestions. I've updated the agenda to include:
- +10m: Data residency & retention patterns (comp)
- +10m: Model fallback & degradation behavior (runtime)

That brings the target to ~75 minutes. Draft agenda file updated and re-attached (redwood-ops-deep-dive-agenda.pdf). The pre-read folder has a short one-pager on data locality and our default retention guardrails. Link again here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4Dredwood-cloudworks-pre-reads

Regarding timing — 7/12 13:00–14:15 PT works for the Redwood presenters. Can you confirm the final attendee list (networking owner + infra ops + compliance observer)? Once confirmed we'll send a calendar invite and add an agenda slide asking each party to call out any hard constraints up front.

Deliverables from Redwood side:
- System overview (Tessa, 10m)
- Network/VPC & peering runbook (Aditya, 25m)
- Data residency & retention patterns (Laura, 10m)
- Model fallback / graceful degradation (Aditya, 15m)
- Open discussion + next steps (Tessa, 15m)

If you want a dry-run with your technical leads before the meeting, we can schedule 30m earlier in the week — happy to do that if helpful.

Thanks,
Tessa
Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-ops-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (updated)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@cloudworks.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops integration deep-dive: proposed agenda, pre-reads, and reschedule options

Quick note from engineering: happy with the agenda. Two asks we should call out in pre-reads so CloudWorks can prep answers: 
- Expected session concurrency for the integration (typical qps, burst patterns) and what SLAs look like under different reserved capacity tiers.
- Whether CloudWorks plans to use shared KV caches or per-customer caches (affects eviction & SLO discussion).

I'll prepare a short slide for the autoscaling/capacity section and upload to the Drive folder by EOD Tue.

-- Aditya
Sr. Backend Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudworks.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Ops integration deep-dive confirmed for Mon 7/12 13:00 PT — calendar invite + prep checklist

Samir / CloudWorks team — confirmed for Mon, 12 Jul 2026, 13:00–14:15 PT. Calendar invite sent from my calendar (you should see it from tessa.morgan@redwood.ai).

Prep checklist for attendees:
- Please review the pre-read folder (Drive) and flag any questions in the doc comments prior to the meeting. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4Dredwood-cloudworks-pre-reads
- Bring the networking owner with ability to answer peering/NAT questions.
- Prepare expected concurrency numbers and any tenant isolation notes (Aditya asked this above).
- If your compliance lead will listen in, send an intro email so we can add a short dedicated slide to the deck.

Who will present on your side? (we have Priya Shah and an infra owner penciled)

Attachments in the invite: redwood-ops-deep-dive-agenda.pdf, system-diagram-v2.svg, pre-read-notes.md

Day-of plan:
- We'll start promptly; please join 5–10 min early if you want to check screenshares.
- Tessa will chair, Aditya will present network/runbook material, Laura will cover data residency.

Thanks — looking forward.

Tessa Morgan
Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-redwood-cloudworks
